biggest_catch: The friend must open a full membership AND a qualifying second product - a 3Point Checking account with direct deposit, or a new loan/Mastercard of at least $3,000 - a plain savings-only join earns you nothing.
catches: Existing member refers via web entry (myGECreditUnion.com) or paper referral form; no limit on people you can refer, but max 10 qualified referrals per member ($250/household).

Friend must: (a) become a NEW member by opening a new membership account AND (b) open either a 3Point Checking Account with Direct Deposit or a new Loan/Mastercard Credit Card Account of at least $3,000.
Cap: maximum 10 qualified referrals and $250 in Referral Bonus Deposits per existing member household (defined by SSN/TIN + household).
Bonus credited to the existing member's membership account within 60 days of the referral completing requirements.
Employees and their families are not eligible; consult a tax advisor on taxability.
No fixed expiry stated on the form.
